secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Your Supabase project URL (e.g. https://zcvahuqajqqvodtezqth.supabase.co). Find it in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable/anon key — the public API key from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (anon/public).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key — the secret server-side key from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (service_role).

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for AI content generation. Obtain from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Encryption key used to encrypt/decrypt OAuth tokens for social scheduling. Any 32+ character random string.

secrets.name: LOVABLE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Lovable platform API key (if using Lovable cloud auth integrations).

secrets.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: LinkedIn OAuth client ID (optional — for LinkedIn social posting).

secrets.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: LinkedIn OAuth client secret (optional — for LinkedIn social posting).

secrets.name: META_APP_ID
secrets.description: Meta/Facebook app ID (optional — for Facebook/Instagram social posting).

secrets.name: META_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: Meta/Facebook app secret (optional — for Facebook/Instagram social posting).
